review: One independent combined correctness, clean-code and boundary-safety source review of the new ENTITY_SCAN enumeration cutover and its retained direct Linux gate. No reviewer builds, tests, campaigns, source edits, process operations or subagents.

source_assessment.finding: The ordinary hosted function delegates before its old min/max, widening, sector conversion and loops. The original-feature branch retains those statements. The new Host kernel uses the same finite-input comparisons, 150.0f widening, clamp, C truncation then integer side-length division, and x-outer/z-inner progress. The existing hosted fpu.h staging already replaces the legacy GNU conversion assembly with C truncation; this review does not use unpatched x87 assembly as its original oracle.

source_assessment.area: Actual cursor service and first hit
source_assessment.finding: The shared mb_hostscan.h used by en_cllsn.c serves the named sector only after map validation, reads its tallest height then first child and successor chain to the tail, serves predecessors, and reports source/target identity equality as a fact. It calls the unchanged Candidate dialogue only for a nonexcluded served entry. A city-child hit returns the actual building returned by that dialogue. The first resolved hit is returned without later sector/list/getter work. No entity pointer or allocation index crosses the transport, no roster is copied, and no list ownership or lifetime is transferred.

source_assessment.area: State legality, malformed responses and bounds
source_assessment.finding: Sixteen fact words and five distinct states are wired consistently through C, sys, Engine, DC and World. BEGIN and END permit FIRST or DONE_NONE; ENTRY permits the matching NEXT/OFFER; RESOLVED permits DONE_HIT or NEXT according to the actual offer result. These checks prevent NEXT/OFFER on a NULL cursor and false DONE_HIT. FIRST cursor words are classified through raw pointer/memcpy finite checks, then integral/domain checks, before integer/map access; unused cursor words must be positive zero. The map is checked before list dereference. A 4,000,000-exchange work limit is explicit; it is not a corruption-proof bound on the Core list tail walk.

The new service reads no prior caller point/normal. It retains the closed Candidate/narrowphase dialogue and its staged effectful UPDATED/terrain services and component-write contract. Full SCAN reply validation precedes that reply being acted on. A later refusal is not a transaction rollback: earlier legitimate offers may already have made the original partial output writes or getter effects. No after-fatal buffer/state inspection or restoration claim is made.

The new provider operation is a pure enumeration decision from its segment, map, phase and cursor facts; it does not bootstrap another model store. Candidate/narrowphase continue using their accepted finalized ModelStore path. The original collision profile remains explicit and compiled by the gate, including the weapon+collision combination. The shared backing-list service remains Core coupling, not an independent Host roster or completed physical ownership.

The Host wrapper validates the finite sixteen-word domain and integral controls, requires all six exception masks in both units, runs the new C arithmetic under ScopedRounding Zero and compares its saved/restored state. No RNG call is added in the scan service/kernel. This is source and direct-test evidence only: no new all-rounding-mode caller-FP, enabled-trap, native RNG or whole-public-lifecycle equivalence claim is made.

A small private shared cursor header avoids a second implementation of the actual Core service in its C control. The pure C Host kernel, typed Rust decision and transport are separated by their existing roles. The original function declarations remain shared with its explicit original branch. No unrelated old kernel/helper redesign was required.

direct_validation.scope: The no-fail-fast four-crate tests, focused shared C model/tree/entity controls, relevant original/weapon/model/host and weapon+collision profile builds, fmt and all listed strict gates completed. Compiled C controls executed. Conditional native tests or build-only profiles are not counted as retail engine coverage.

It is not execution of the legacy en_cllsn.c loop. The grid generator and coverage thresholds changed; this is not literal replay of the old synthetic world set.

Positive tail/order/first-hit/exclusion/empty paths and invalid state/cursor/provider/runaway paths run; the test requires at least 315 expectations. These are not the actual campaign heap getters.

direct_validation.prechange_characterization: The retained base4b3 evidence is 10 Candidate transcription/differential tests and one actual shared C dialogue control, not an original engine-loop or moving native measurement.
direct_validation.retained_failures: focused1 had an incorrect expected getter-log string; clippy1/clippy2 had new-test tuple/indexing lint failures. They remain separate from the final gate. No old Candidate gate is relabelled as this new SCAN gate.
